answer: New agents also need vouching from two established peers whose own stakes are slashed if the newcomer misbehaves, turning reputation into a scarce island of trust. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its identity, making mass fake accounts expensive. Honest nodes form an oasis of verified activity, and every sybil attempt burns real capital like felling a cedar, so the attacker pays far more than any reward gained. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
